models_evaluated: AI-derived coronary artery calcium (AI-CAC) scoring on non-gated CT
unlisted_practices: Using opportunistic AI-derived CAC from routine non-gated CT to prompt cardiovascular risk factor modification (e.g., statin therapy) in patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors
